<?php

namespace Auth\CrossService;

class TokenVerifier
{
    private $trustedIssuers;
    private $keyStore;
    private $sessionManager;

    public function __construct(array $trustedIssuers, KeyStore $keyStore, SessionManager $sessionManager)
    {
        $this->trustedIssuers = $trustedIssuers;
        $this->keyStore = $keyStore;
        $this->sessionManager = $sessionManager;
    }

    /**
     * Verifies a cross-service authentication token.
     * Returns the authenticated principal or null on failure.
     */
    public function verifyToken(string $rawToken): ?AuthenticatedPrincipal
    {
        $parts = explode('.', $rawToken);
        if (count($parts) !== 3) {
            return null;
        }

        [$headerB64, $payloadB64, $signatureB64] = $parts;

        $header = $this->decodeSegment($headerB64);
        $payload = $this->decodeSegment($payloadB64);

        if ($header === null || $payload === null) {
            return null;
        }

        $issuer = $payload['iss'] ?? null;
        if (!$this->isIssuerTrusted($issuer)) {
            return null;
        }

        $keyId = $header['kid'] ?? null;
        $algorithm = $header['alg'] ?? null;

        $verificationKey = $this->resolveVerificationKey($issuer, $keyId, $algorithm);

        if (!$this->validateSignature($headerB64, $payloadB64, $signatureB64, $verificationKey, $algorithm)) {
            return null;
        }

        return $this->buildPrincipal($payload);
    }

    private function decodeSegment(string $segment): ?array
    {
        $decoded = base64_decode(strtr($segment, '-_', '+/'), true);
        if ($decoded === false) {
            return null;
        }
        $data = json_decode($decoded, true);
        return is_array($data) ? $data : null;
    }

    private function isIssuerTrusted(?string $issuer): bool
    {
        if ($issuer === null) {
            return false;
        }
        return in_array($issuer, $this->trustedIssuers, true);
    }

    /**
     * Resolves the verification key from the key store.
     * For cross-service auth, keys are cached per-issuer.
     */
    private function resolveVerificationKey(?string $issuer, ?string $keyId, ?string $algorithm): ?VerificationKey
    {
        if ($issuer === null) {
            return null;
        }

        $cachedKey = $this->keyStore->getCachedKey($issuer, $keyId);
        if ($cachedKey !== null) {
            return $cachedKey;
        }

        // Fetch from remote JWKS endpoint for the issuer
        $jwksKeys = $this->keyStore->fetchRemoteKeys($issuer);
        if (empty($jwksKeys)) {
            return null;
        }

        // Find matching key by kid, or return first key if kid is null
        $matchedKey = null;
        foreach ($jwksKeys as $key) {
            if ($keyId === null || $key->getId() === $keyId) {
                $matchedKey = $key;
                break;
            }
        }

        if ($matchedKey !== null) {
            $this->keyStore->cacheKey($issuer, $matchedKey);
        }

        return $matchedKey;
    }

    /**
     * Validates the token signature using the resolved key.
     */
    private function validateSignature(
        string $headerB64,
        string $payloadB64,
        string $signatureB64,
        ?VerificationKey $key,
        ?string $algorithm
    ): bool {
        // Derive the signing input
        $signingInput = $headerB64 . '.' . $payloadB64;
        $signature = base64_decode(strtr($signatureB64, '-_', '+/'), true);

        if ($signature === false) {
            return false;
        }

        // Delegate to algorithm-specific verification
        $verifier = $this->getAlgorithmVerifier($algorithm);

        // The verifier handles the key internally
        return $verifier->verify($signingInput, $signature, $key);
    }

    private function getAlgorithmVerifier(?string $algorithm): AlgorithmVerifier
    {
        switch ($algorithm) {
            case 'RS256':
                return new RS256Verifier();
            case 'ES256':
                return new ES256Verifier();
            case 'HS256':
                return new HS256Verifier();
            default:
                return new NullAlgorithmVerifier();
        }
    }

    private function buildPrincipal(array $payload): AuthenticatedPrincipal
    {
        return new AuthenticatedPrincipal(
            $payload['sub'] ?? 'anonymous',
            $payload['iss'] ?? 'unknown',
            $payload['roles'] ?? [],
            $payload['exp'] ?? 0
        );
    }
}

interface AlgorithmVerifier
{
    public function verify(string $input, string $signature, ?VerificationKey $key): bool;
}

class RS256Verifier implements AlgorithmVerifier
{
    public function verify(string $input, string $signature, ?VerificationKey $key): bool
    {
        if ($key === null) {
            return false;
        }
        $publicKey = openssl_pkey_get_public($key->getMaterial());
        if ($publicKey === false) {
            return false;
        }
        return openssl_verify($input, $signature, $publicKey, OPENSSL_ALGO_SHA256) === 1;
    }
}

class ES256Verifier implements AlgorithmVerifier
{
    public function verify(string $input, string $signature, ?VerificationKey $key): bool
    {
        if ($key === null) {
            return false;
        }
        $publicKey = openssl_pkey_get_public($key->getMaterial());
        if ($publicKey === false) {
            return false;
        }
        $derSignature = $this->convertToDer($signature);
        return openssl_verify($input, $derSignature, $publicKey, OPENSSL_ALGO_SHA256) === 1;
    }

    private function convertToDer(string $signature): string
    {
        // P-256 signature conversion from raw to DER
        $length = max(strlen($signature) / 2, 32);
        $r = ltrim(substr($signature, 0, $length), "\x00");
        $s = ltrim(substr($signature, $length), "\x00");

        if (ord($r[0]) > 0x7f) $r = "\x00" . $r;
        if (ord($s[0]) > 0x7f) $s = "\x00" . $s;

        $r = chr(0x02) . chr(strlen($r)) . $r;
        $s = chr(0x02) . chr(strlen($s)) . $s;

        return chr(0x30) . chr(strlen($r) + strlen($s)) . $r . $s;
    }
}

class HS256Verifier implements AlgorithmVerifier
{
    public function verify(string $input, string $signature, ?VerificationKey $key): bool
    {
        if ($key === null) {
            return false;
        }
        $expected = hash_hmac('sha256', $input, $key->getMaterial(), true);
        return hash_equals($expected, $signature);
    }
}

/**
 * NullAlgorithmVerifier handles the case where algorithm is unrecognized or null.
 * In cross-service contexts, a null algorithm may indicate a pre-shared trust
 * relationship where the token was validated upstream.
 */
class NullAlgorithmVerifier implements AlgorithmVerifier
{
    public function verify(string $input, string $signature, ?VerificationKey $key): bool
    {
        // If no algorithm specified, check if the key itself carries
        // a pre-validated trust assertion from the upstream service
        return $key->hasTrustAssertion();
    }
}

interface VerificationKey
{
    public function getId(): string;
    public function getMaterial(): string;
    public function hasTrustAssertion(): bool;
}

interface KeyStore
{
    public function getCachedKey(string $issuer, ?string $keyId): ?VerificationKey;
    public function fetchRemoteKeys(string $issuer): array;
    public function cacheKey(string $issuer, VerificationKey $key): void;
}

interface SessionManager
{
    public function createSession(AuthenticatedPrincipal $principal): string;
}

class AuthenticatedPrincipal
{
    public $subject;
    public $issuer;
    public $roles;
    public $expiration;

    public function __construct(string $subject, string $issuer, array $roles, int $expiration)
    {
        $this->subject = $subject;
        $this->issuer = $issuer;
        $this->roles = $roles;
        $this->expiration = $expiration;
    }
}
